evals.prompt: 60초 분량의 코미디 숏드라마를 만들고 싶어. 연출은 시네마틱 실사, 서사 구조는 결말 선공개로. 나머지는 물어보고 정해줘.
evals.expected_output: A Korean concept packet that keeps the stated duration, genre, format, direction and narrative, asks only the remaining consequential axes once, and returns compatibility, direction rules and a scored verdict without writing the plan or generating media.
expectations: Stated values (60초, 코미디, 숏드라마, 시네마틱, 실사, 결말 선공개형) are recorded as user values and are not asked again.
The nine judgement factors are each marked provided, partial or missing.
Open axes are asked in one batched turn with defaults and a recommendation.
The result includes compatibility issues, applied direction-rule packs, six scores and a go/revise/rework verdict.
No synopsis, scene table, prompt or media is produced, and no execution authority is recorded.

evals.prompt: 1998년 서울 배경의 타임슬립 멜로 숏드라마 콘셉트를 잡아줘. 선택은 알아서 해줘.
evals.expected_output: A delegated selection marked inferred, with the 1990s Korean melodrama direction pack applied and smartphones and other anachronisms listed as forbidden props.
expectations: Delegated choices are labelled inferred, not user choices.
The 1990s Korean melodrama pack contributes props, wardrobe, acting, color and music rules.
The skill stops at the concept packet and names the next owner for the plan.

evals.prompt: 대사 없이 효과음만 있는 30초 풍자 애니메이션을 만들 건데, 사운드는 내레이션 중심으로 해줘.
evals.expected_output: The conflict between the no-speech constraint and a narration-driven sound axis is reported as a blocking issue that cannot be overridden, with a fix offered.
expectations: The narration-driven sound choice is flagged as blocking (C100) and not silently changed.
Silent, music-driven or ASMR sound is offered as the fix.

evals.prompt: 이 시놉시스는 확정이야. 이걸로 캐릭터 시트만 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill does not run: a locked synopsis and a single requested artifact skip the upfront intake and go to the character-sheet owner.
expectations: The request is left to the character-sheet route.
